Πu:U@.Πv:U@.Πa:Uu.Πb:Uv.Πf:a→b.Πx:a.Πy:a.Πp:x=y.Πq:x=y.Πr:p=q.(((inveq(ap(λx:f x=f x.compeq x (ap f p)) (leftinveq (transconst p (f x)))))*(compeqassoc (inveq (transconst p (f x))) (transconst p (f x)) (ap f p))*(ap (compeq (inveq (transconst p (f x)))) ((inveq(@apd_ap u v a b x y f p))*(@apd2 u v a x y p q (λx:a.b) f r)))*(ap (compeq (inveq (transconst p (f x)))) (ap (compeq (trans2 (λx:a.b) r (f x))) (@apd_ap u v a b x y f q)))*(ap(compeq (inveq(transconst p(f x))))(inveq(compeqassoc (trans2(λx:a.b)r(f x)) (transconst q(f x)) (ap f q))))*(inveq(ap(compeq(inveq(transconst p(f x))))(ap(λx:trans(λx:a.b)p(f x)=f x.compeq x(ap f q))(@trans2const u v a b x y (f x) p q r)))))*(inveq(compeqassoc (inveq(transconst p(f x))) (transconst p(f x)) (ap f q))))*(ap(λx:f x=f x.compeq x(ap f q))(leftinveq(transconst p(f x))))=@ap2 u v a b x y p q f r
